observationType: Original paraphrase of public behavior documentation; no implementation or test inspection
contracts: A configurable minimum token length determines reported repeated blocks.
Identical-token comparison is the default; selected languages can optionally normalize identifiers or literals.
Language-specific controls also cover annotations, literal sequences, using directives and skipped blocks.
Lexical errors and detected duplicates affect exit status unless explicitly disabled.
Text and structured reports are available; file collection and integration interfaces are documented separately.
nativeScope: Original bounded token pairs in twelve grammar-backed language domains, exact defaults and explicit normalization; complete CPD lexical and option equivalence remains unverified
